pr_metadata.title: Fix idempotency handling for retry flow
pr_metadata.author: dev-user

comparison_results.change_summary: Adds key-based lock and retry guard for duplicate requests.
comparison_results.behavioral_change: Duplicate requests now return cached response instead of reprocessing.
risk_flags: Lock timeout could surface false negatives under heavy load
comparison_results.semantic_impact: Improves consistency and idempotency behavior for clients.

review_result.summary: PR improves reliability for retry scenarios with moderate concurrency risk.

issues_found.issue: No metrics added for lock contention path.
issues_found.recommendation: Add contention counter and alert threshold.

suggested_comments.body: Consider emitting a metric when lock acquisition fails to aid production debugging.

review_result.reasoning: Core behavior is correct; observability improvements can be follow-up work.
